design.edge: Optional role edge.width is positive finite semantic-local width; native preflight requires positive integer physical thickness before any allocation. Default is exactly one physical pixel, independent of source/skin/label context. Other edge metadata remains copied/frozen. Partition top/bottom and remaining left/right in physical coordinates, clamp to allocation, then project back. No overlapping corners or tiny-bound double coverage.
design.opacity: Optional immutable role and transient native-state opacity in finite 0..1. Rect/Image commands carry selected role opacity with default1; every keyed reconciliation calls public setAlpha, including reset. Covers flat/skin/glyph/icon/feedback and other stock parts without tint/color changes. Existing disabled>pressed>hover>focus>base selection remains.
design.stateLink: button or itemSlot owners; text/icon and leaf flat-panel consumers only. Panels cannot have labels, descendants, own actions/focus, or focus-order/default/cancel authority. Same-parent/no-chain/no-cycle/dangling guards stay. Layout retains parentId after flattening; interaction independently checks topology, includes it in semantic revision identity, and requires it for panel links. Legacy text/icon plans may omit it.
design.construction: ItemSlot owns item art, action and opaque magenta feedback role; same-size flat panel sibling consumes state with base opacity0, focus/hover/pressed .3, disabled0. It follows the item without new input owner. The same-magenta wash above art/edge leaves the opaque edge unchanged.
design.lifetime: Pure preflight failure leaves published allocation and held state intact. Native alpha setter failures retire/drain owned objects/frames/listeners. Existing source-plane byte budget, pixel compression, object/fragment limits, clipping and extension lifecycle remain.
design.declarations: NativeObject.setAlpha, ThemeEdge.width and preserved metadata, role/state opacity, bounded UiMetadata link docs, typed optional parentId, actual Phaser Image/Rectangle assignment and negative opacity/edge fixture cases.
